title: 便携TNT发生器
description: The Portable TNT Generator builds up massive total damage through a series of small explosions! Be careful—the Continuous Portable TNT Generator may backfire. You can enchant it with “Backfire Protection.” To get it, trade with the Librarian~
body:
# My Goal
I developed this mod to make using explosives in survival mode easier.
## 1
**Adds two types of TNT generators**: one that fires a single shot and one that fires continuously (the first has 200 durability, the second has 500).
## 2
If you're not sure where to start, try obtaining a **Creeper's Head**—the recipe book will guide you through the next steps.
## 3
**The continuous portable TNT generator has a 2% chance of backfiring**, causing a massive explosion. You can enchant it with “**Backfire Protection**” to reduce most of the explosion damage (this cannot be crafted at an enchanting table; you must trade with villagers or obtain it through loot tables).
